## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      4 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 20, 2026 - Sep 29, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _re ggie_, Sep 29, 2026, 1/5: "I decided not to proceed with a subscription with this app because when trying to look over MY PLAN, I noticed no actual plan/account information with options to continue or cancel. Also, its not in my apple subscriptions. Very odd to me. So I went into my email, only to find it in my SPAM, they stated it will auto-renew with my card. When trying to click the link to cancel auto-renew, it doesn't work! Sent an email to support, "PLEASE DO NOT AUTO-RENEW". Never has an app subscription been so difficult to cancel."
            2. _Upset user45552_, Sep 24, 2026, 1/5: "I Used It For One Day And Got A Trainer So I Canceled My Subscription And They’re Still Trying To Take A Payment Of $96 From My Account ."
            3. _Chandaman3643_, Sep 24, 2026, 4/5: "Why do I have to pay why can’t I js use it it looks so perfect then I see a subscription I wish it was free because I would be SUPER happy but now I am not…:("
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jan 24, 2026 - Sep 26, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _mo4958589594_, Jan 24, 2026, 2/5: "The app has so much potential but is so broken. It alerts me on the wrong days, it does a ludicrous amount of reps and weight for where I’m at in my fitness ability, it will give me 6 exercises for my biceps in one day when my split is meant to be full body every work out. It COULD be great, but it’s not there. I won’t be renewing my subscription"
            2. _East County Mom_, Sep 23, 2026, 3/5: "App glitches more often than not. Workouts don’t always feel like they flow well together."
            3. _Beeezy69_, Sep 26, 2026, 5/5: "First and foremost the app was great did everything it said it was going to do. Super clean ai even gives you a trail to try it out. I had an issue (completely on my end) and support genuinely got back to me within 5 minutes and solved the problem. There are a lot of fitness apps out there. But this one is solid, and if you have an issue they are 100% ready to help."
<!--/ir-theme-->
